## Elder Onaryx (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
NE Huge outsider (evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +6; **Senses** blindsense 90 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +20  


**Defense**


**AC** 27, touch 8, flat-footed 27 (+11 armor, +8 natural, –2 size)  
**hp** 240 (15d10+90); fast healing 10  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +11, **Will** +9  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)  
**Melee** 2 claws +23 (2d6+9)  
**Ranged** photon blaster +13 touch (blindness 1d4 rounds, Reflex DC 18 negates), ultari plasma javelin +13 touch (3d6 electricity and 3d6 fire/x3)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** flyby rake, sonic cry (DC 22, 120-ft. line; concussive, echolocate, maddening, mind-erasing, nauseating, sonic thrust, terrifying)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 29, **Dex** 10, **Con** 21, **Int** 12, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 36 (40 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Quick Draw, Weapon Focus (claw), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md); [Deadly Aim](../../rules/feats/deadly-aim.md) (no feat needed), [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard is part of Toughness; Deadly Aim, Power Attack need no feat; in their place: Lightning Reflexes, Great Fortitude.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +8 (+11 when jumping), Bluff +18, Climb +17, Fly +9, Intimidate +21, Perception +20, Stealth +4, Survival +18; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Acrobatics when jumping  
**Languages** Onaryx, Ultari  
**Gear** +1 shocktrooper armor, photon blaster, ultari plasma javelin  
**SQ** battle-tech trained
